name: agentic-development-kit
description: A collection of tools and plugins for agentic development.

plugins.name: markdown
plugins.description: Markdown authoring skills, marksman LSP integration, and a session-scoped markdownlint fix loop.

plugins.name: prettier
plugins.description: Formats every file with Prettier the moment Claude edits or writes it.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git workflow helpers for Claude Code, including safety-checked branch creation and staged/confirmed Conventional Commits commit creation.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Opens the pull request for the current branch with a Conventional Commits title and an evidence-derived description, watches its checks, resolves failures, and merges on confirmation.
